steps.name: Salt if you decide (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] in “Nidaros” and enter the scenario dungeon “Sandy Beach” in “Salaar Coast.” Then report the quest to [Carmen] inside.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Left foot forward. Right foot back.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Haha… . I need to get some rest. Be sure to stick around next time, Carmen. Don't fall again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey there.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Who are you? I got permission to practice dancing here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it, it was sent by Embla. He told me to go talk to Carmen.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Are you Embla’s older sister? Hmm, what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They asked me to get a part-time job.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Eh… .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ah, it was our first meeting, but he showed this facial expression. Wait a minute, calm your expression. braided.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hehe, my name is Carmen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ooooh! %s, I heard a lot of rumors. He's an amazing person.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Who was the subject of the rumor I heard in Glaston? It was %s. Wow. It's cool.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I'll ask for your autograph later. Hehe, my hobby is collecting autographs of famous people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will do it. But what is a part-time job?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Now… Do I have to do it?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I've tried various part-time jobs in the village, but I always worry about Embla's part-time job.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Because it is the most annoying and the most difficult. Instead, the hourly wage is a bit higher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is happening... .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: It's nothing special, it's about getting salt crystals from Salar Coast. It looks pink at the beach, but if you look closely, it's red.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I'm not sure, but it's probably an ingredient in a drink made from ash trees.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: These are not regular salt crystals; you need to choose ones that do not break easily, but they are not easy to find.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Lately, ghost-like monsters have been appearing out of nowhere targeting me, so I'm really tired.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ha, it was okay because Askren helped me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come with me. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Really? Hehe, good. Then follow me♬

steps.name: Salt if you decide (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] at the “Sandy Beach” and use the excavation skill in the dungeon to obtain <Red Salt Crystal>. Then go outside and report the quest to [Carmen] in [Nidaros].

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Whoa, we're there.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: You can find salt crystals on the sandy beach that can be seen from here to the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't see any monsters now.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: However, from the moment you step on that side, monsters will randomly appear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If a monster appears from over there, wouldn't it be dangerous here too?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I thought so too, so I checked with Askren the other day, but strangely enough, it didn't come to this point.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I had a feeling they were looking for something other than salt crystals, but I wasn't sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Hey, let me take a moment to catch my breath. I'm a little nervous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Carmen, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: I had a hard time running away last time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems very unsettling... , I will go alone. Carmen is waiting here.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Really? I would really appreciate it if you could do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is what Embla asked me to do. I will do it.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Now, I'll show you how to get salt crystals.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Try using the [Excavation] skill in front of a rock-like red salt lump.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: If you're lucky, you'll get the crystal right away, but if you're unlucky, ghost-like monsters will appear and interfere with %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the end, you have to leave it to luck. How much can I bring?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: You just need ten. My sister told me not to be greedy and to always bring only ten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Carmen. I'll be back as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Huh? uh? uh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Carmen, it's over.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Already? Wow, you are so amazing. I thought Askren was fast too... .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Just looking at it makes me speechless. Wow… . Plus, the salt crystals are in great condition!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Shall we go back to the village now?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like someone is there. Maybe it's just my mood... .

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Who is there? There are only two of us here now... . Could it be a ghost?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Well, there's nothing like that here.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Aaaah, %s. It really looks like there's a ghost!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't mean to scare you.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Ah, I can't hear you. There is no such thing as ears or ghosts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I understand. Then come back quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s too strange to blame it on my mood. There’s definitely something going on around Salar Coast….)
(After Carmen and Adventurer leave, a hologram that looks like a silhouette rises from the ground on a cliff in the distance.)
“Search ends. 2049234th session.”
「Target object cannot be identified, coordinates reset… .」
“Target energy detected on Salar Coast, but not confirmed.”
“Data reset for ‘wing’ operation.”
「Detecting target energy in the sea, underwater... .」

steps.name: Salt if you decide (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Carmen] and [Askren] in “Nidaros” and report the quest to [Askren] in “Nidaros.”

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Haha, haha. It's been a while since I ran as hard as I could and I'm out of breath.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel safe because no one is chasing me.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Whoa. Yes, I'll be relieved. %s, thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to Carmen, it ended well.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: What? I will bring the salt crystals to Embla.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Carmen, you've been looking for a long time. Oh, %s was there too.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Why? What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You can't go to the beach.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Have we already been there?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: With %s?

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Yeah. Embla unnie asked me something.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: In that case, you should have called me. We've been together so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Askren, have you been looking at the sandy beach the whole time...?)

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: No matter how hard you search, there must be a priest. Since %s helped me, I won't be going out again today.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Okay, kid.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Where is this big kid?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's here. Before your eyes.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: Phew, I don't even have the energy to joke around with Askren. Then, I will go to see Embla. After I return, I have to practice again.

lines.speaker: 카르멘
lines.text: %s, thank you. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Carmen.
(Carmen walks towards where Embla is, holding the salt crystal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Askren. You said before that you would help if there was anything you could do, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something on the sandy beach? The reason I went with Carmen wasn't just to help... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because there's something there, right?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Would you like to follow me for a moment? There are a lot of eyes watching here.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There are no people gathering here to see me. I think I can tell you now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me without joking.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, that was annoying. Then let’s get straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The reason why I followed Carmen to the sandy beach all this time... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: This is because I sensed the energy of the ancient ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ancient ruins?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: As a priest of the Hodmis Church, my job is to search for ancient ruins, transport the discovered artifacts to the Order, and interpret them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You do something similar to an archaeologist.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's a little different. While an archaeologist is a person who looks back on the past through relics and ruins, as a priest, I am a person who covers them so they cannot be revealed again.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: According to the standards of the church, things that are judged to be dangerous due to the power of twisted people and demons are sealed or eliminated.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Of course, within the scope possible.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Currently, the Salar Coast is filled with the energy of ancient ruins. I can't say for sure what type it is, but it's quite dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What felt like déjà vu was… .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's not exact, but it's likely that's the effect.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The energy pervading the coast has a strong feeling of the twilight era, but the monsters that appeared on the sandy beach seem to be the type that appeared during the chaotic sky era.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The Creed clan and the Sylvaria Empire knights who disappeared at that time... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Phew, that's as much as I found out. Was this helpful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I need to find out a little more, but I think it will be an important clue.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What you just heard is a secret to the outside world. This information is only permitted to %s, who follows the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's unlikely to happen, but if it leaks out... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'd rather not talk about this. It's not my type of thing to say terrible thoughts out loud. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The rest is a secret. A priest with a secret, isn’t he attractive in his own way? Hehehe. I will now go to Embla. See you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I get it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is going on here...)
